pm.title: IT Project Management Services
pm.text: Learn how to plan, execute, and deliver IT projects on time and on budget. Covers project lifecycles, stakeholder communication, risk management, and real-world case studies from international teams.

jira.title: Jira & Kanban Toolset Training
jira.text: Master Jira from board setup to advanced workflows: backlogs, sprints, epics, automation rules, dashboards, and Kanban board design for efficient team delivery.

metaads.title: Meta Ads & Social Media Marketing
metaads.text: Build, launch, and optimize Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns. Learn audience research, creative testing, budget allocation, pixel setup, and performance analytics.

agile.title: Agile & Scrum Certification Prep
agile.text: Understand Scrum roles, ceremonies, and artifacts. Prepare for industry-recognized certifications while practicing on simulated sprint cycles and retrospectives.

freelance.title: Freelance & Remote Work Readiness
freelance.text: Position yourself for remote PM and marketing roles. Build your portfolio, LinkedIn presence, and pitch process for platforms like Upwork and direct outreach.
